rock-collecting.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE square 4-by-4 vocabulary picture atlas, 16 objects in exactly 16 equal invisible square cells, for four chapters of a children's reading assessment. Original Pixar-style polished 3D rendering, charming realistic materials, clear silhouettes, warm soft studio light, gentle contact shadows. Background in ALL cells uniform warm ivory (#fffefa). A separate requested object is centred INSIDE THE CENTRAL 70% of each cell with generous margins so each can be displayed independently. Exactly four rows and four columns, no objects crossing cells. Row 1, left to right: one large round grey rock; one small red rock; a tan drawstring cloth bag; an empty shallow rectangular wooden tray.
Row 2, left to right: a soft cleaning brush with wooden handle; a round hand lens with a short black handle; a dark grey rock visibly wet with water droplets and a small puddle; a warm yellow sun with simple rays, no face.
Row 3, left to right: a low broad FLAT rock like a thin smooth grey slate pebble, very visibly flattened with a level top, seen in low three-quarter perspective; a tall rounded BUMPY grey rock with several obvious large rounded bumps and knobbles across its surface, seen at the same angle, clearly different from the flat rock; a small open brown cardboard box; a child's open hand with five natural fingers and a bit of wrist, no arm beyond the wrist.
Row 4, left to right: an open notebook with blank white pages; one wooden pencil; a blank paper specimen label with short string; a small collection of FOUR visibly different stones together on an ivory surface, no container. The flat and bumpy rocks, if present, must differ unmistakably in SHAPE rather than just colour: flat has a thin broad level profile; bumpy has a knobbly uneven profile. No words, labels, numerals, watermarks, frames, divider lines, checkerboards, decorative panels, arrows or additional objects. Keep each illustrated object fully visible. No text even on maps or notebooks.
